LanguageData.RHAH_ContentPreset_Introduction:
This mod (Ratkin: Hunger and Havoc) draws on fantasy and historical hardships. Some content may not suit everyone. Before playing the new version, choose which events you are comfortable encountering. General or all-ages events suit players who prefer to avoid distressing realism and cruelty. Cruel or uncomfortably realistic events suit those looking for a harsher world.

You can also choose a preset later on the Overview settings page.

If cruel or realistic content makes you uncomfortable, switch to general or all-ages events.

The four presets differ in plague progression, lethality and transmission, available events, negative effects and the amount of food requested. If you are unsure, general events are recommended.

Cruel: the original default events and effects.
Realistic: excludes explicit bloody scenes such as the young ratkin suicide squad.
General: plague progression and negative effects at 75%; food demands and food trade costs halved. Excludes child exchange, the dangerous ratkin settlement, mutilated young ratkin and similar events.
All ages: plague progression and negative effects at 25%; plague is nonlethal and does not spread. Excludes slave or prisoner trading and other unsuitable events.

General and all-ages presets prevent famine visitors from opening doors. Refusing visitors causes hostility only for hungry refugee sieges and their strong or plague variants.
